patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Download the patch from the link below. Once you have downloaded the file, locate the steam directory for the game (right click on the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. To apply the patch, copy the contents of the patch zip-file to that directory. Overwrite any existing files if prompted. It's working if: When you start a game, it asks if you would like to Enable or Disable Adult Content in this playthrough. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
